headline: Sacyr and Cointer Secure $375 Million Financing to Expand Chilean Airports
summary: Sacyr and Cointer secured $375 million in financing to fund the expansion of the Antofagasta and Atacama airports in Chile.
why: Airport infrastructure concession financing facilitates large-scale civil engineering projects and transportation capacity growth.

impacts.name: Sacyr
impacts.why: Securing project financing enables the execution of airport expansion works.
